sources.entry: Thelia - Thelia is an open source and flexible e-commerce solution. (Demo, Source Code) LGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Thelia is an open source PHP e-commerce framework for building online stores and managing web content, and this repository is its development codebase.
summary.what_it_does: This is the development repository for Thelia 3, where work on the framework itself happens; the README says to create a shop from the thelia/thelia-project skeleton instead. Version 3 is built on Symfony 7.4 LTS, API Platform 4.3 (standalone), and the Propel ORM. It ships a Twig front office (the Flexy theme) and a Twig back office (default-twig), built with Symfony UX and Bootstrap 5. API authentication uses Lexik JWT. The README covers installation via bin/install with database and admin flags, asset building with importmap, tailwind and sass commands, and production asset compilation. It also lists PHPUnit, php-cs-fixer and PHPStan commands for testing and quality checks.
use_cases: manage web content for a shop
run a PHP e-commerce back office
stack: Symfony UX (Stimulus, Twig Components, Live Components)
notable: Flexy Twig front-office theme and default-twig back office
Built on Symfony 7.4 LTS with API Platform 4.3 for API access
Install script (bin/install) can seed demo data and an admin account from flags
Dev stack documented around DDEV, with no Docker setup shipped in the repo
caveats: This repository is the framework's development codebase; the README directs shop owners to the thelia-project skeleton instead
Requires PHP 8.3+ and a MariaDB 10.11+ or MySQL 8.x database, plus several PHP extensions
The repo ships no Docker setup; the maintainers use DDEV, and other stacks need manual setup
The Smarty back office from Thelia 2 is no longer installed or maintained in 3.x
